precedence_rule: explicit argument > canonical environment variable > legacy alias environment variable > documented safe default (absent value); every explicitly supplied INVALID value refuses deterministically (ConfigurationError / FailClosedTarget) and never silently falls back
working_directory_rule: no configured value may depend on the process CWD; repo-relative defaults derive from the repository location (phase3.paths project discovery) only

variables.name: FIE_HTTP_HOST
variables.validation: non-empty string after strip; empty resets to default
variables.failure_mode: n/a (absent -> default; no malformed class for a string host)

variables.name: FIE_HTTP_PORT
variables.failure_mode: refusal INVALID_HTTP_PORT (explicitly supplied non-numeric/negative/>65535)

variables.name: FIE_AUTH_MODE
variables.failure_mode: refusal UNKNOWN_AUTH_MODE; AUTH_MODE_FORBIDDEN_IN_PRODUCTION under production-like profiles

variables.name: FIE_AUTH_TOKEN
variables.required: conditional: required when FIE_AUTH_MODE=token under staging/production; fail-closed at the authenticator otherwise
variables.failure_mode: refusal AUTH_CREDENTIAL_MISSING under production-like; authenticator construction refusal otherwise

variables.name: FIE_AUTH_PRINCIPAL
variables.failure_mode: n/a

variables.name: FIE_LOG_LEVEL
variables.failure_mode: refusal INVALID_LOG_LEVEL

variables.name: FIE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
variables.failure_mode: refusal INVALID_REQUEST_TIMEOUT

variables.name: FIE_SQLITE_ACCESS_MODE
variables.failure_mode: refusal UNKNOWN_ACCESS_MODE

variables.name: FIE_SERVICE_ENV
variables.validation: vocabulary local|test|staging|production (also classified rehearsal/production by phase3.runtime_contract)
variables.failure_mode: refusal UNKNOWN_SERVICE_ENV (runtime_config) / FAIL_CLOSED_PRODUCTION_MODE_DECLARATION_REQUIRED (guard layer); under staging/production the production-like gates require DSN + non-none auth

variables.name: FIE_LOG_FORMAT
variables.failure_mode: refusal INVALID_LOG_FORMAT

variables.name: FIE_DB_TARGET_RAW
variables.required: required by the raw layer at every use (no implicit default)
variables.secret: value may embed credentials (DSN); never echoed — masked forms only
variables.validation: phase3.runtime_contract.parse_target (explicit backend class; absolute SQLite path or postgres(ql):// DSN)
variables.failure_mode: FailClosedTarget exit 78 classes: FAIL_CLOSED_DB_TARGET_REQUIRED / FAIL_CLOSED_MALFORMED_DB_TARGET / FAIL_CLOSED_CONTRADICTORY_DB_TARGETS

variables.name: FIE_DB_TARGET_INTELLIGENCE
variables.required: required by the Phase 3B store/persistence seam at every resolution (no implicit default)
variables.secret: value may embed credentials (DSN); masked forms only
variables.failure_mode: FailClosedTarget classes as FIE_DB_TARGET_RAW; surfaced as ConfigurationError DATABASE_URL_* by phase3.service.runtime_config/transport.config

variables.name: FIE_DB_TARGET_TEST
variables.default: none (absent -> fail-closed when that resolution is attempted)
variables.failure_mode: FailClosedTarget classes

variables.name: FIE_DB_TARGET_ROLLBACK
variables.failure_mode: FailClosedTarget classes

variables.name: FIE_DB_PATH
variables.note: LEGACY ALIAS of FIE_DB_TARGET_RAW (6.8A normalization) AND the guard-reference path selector in phase3.paths; deprecated for the raw-layer DB-target role — canonical name preferred; contradictory aliases fail closed
variables.failure_mode: same refusal classes as the raw role; contradiction with the canonical var fails closed

variables.name: FIE_DATABASE_URL
variables.note: LEGACY ALIAS of FIE_DB_TARGET_INTELLIGENCE (6.8A normalization); canonical name preferred
variables.failure_mode: same refusal classes as the intelligence role

variables.name: FIE_INTELLIGENCE_DB
variables.note: LEGACY ALIAS of FIE_DB_TARGET_INTELLIGENCE (6.8A normalization); deprecated — canonical name preferred
variables.failure_mode: same refusal classes as the intelligence role

variables.name: FIE_PROJECT_ROOT
variables.failure_mode: n/a

variables.name: FIE_DATA_DIR
variables.failure_mode: when phase3.paths is unimportable in legacy fetchers, an UNSET value refuses (CWD fallback removed, 6.9B-R1 C-1)

variables.name: FIE_CONFIG_DIR
variables.failure_mode: when phase3.paths is unimportable in legacy fetchers, an UNSET value refuses (CWD fallback removed, 6.9B-R1 C-1); resolved LAZILY everywhere since 6.9B-R1 (C-4)

variables.name: FIE_ARTIFACT_DIR
variables.failure_mode: n/a

variables.name: FIE_PRODUCTION_DB_CONTRACT
variables.failure_mode: FailClosedTarget FAIL_CLOSED_PRODUCTION_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE (missing/unreadable/DSN-free set proves nothing)

variables.name: FIE_WRAPPER_ENV
variables.validation: absolute path to an operator-owned 0600 env file
variables.failure_mode: wrapper refuse when unset and required by the guard discipline

file_sources.default: NONE — missing file/key/mis-typed value refuses (6.9B-R1 C-2/C-3; the historical fail-open default true is abolished)
